blocks.orig: Marera Valley Lodge is a charming lodge with spacious rooms boasting large beds, sitting areas, bathrooms with inside and outside showers and private balconies. The lodge is nestled in a valley close to Karatu, in between Lake Manyara National Park and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. The large swimming pool is beautifully set in a hilly landscape and everywhere in this lodge you can enjoy panoramic views of the valley. Last not but least, you will find delicious food here as the owner himself is a chef!
blocks.html: With its spacious rooms, Marera Valley Lodge is a charming place to stay: each room has a large bed, a sitting area, a bathroom with indoor and outdoor showers and a private balcony. You find the lodge tucked away in a valley near Karatu, between Lake Manyara National Park and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. The big swimming pool lies beautifully in the hilly scenery, and from all over the lodge you have panoramic views of the valley. Finally, the food here is delicious, because the owner is a chef himself!
